relics of the apostles & martyrs the parish of newtownards & comber has the privilege of being the custodian of relics of the holy apostles, martrys of the 2nd & 3rd centuries, in addition to other relics on temporary loan to the parish . the relics will be on display for the feast of all saints this weekend 31st october/1st november. those attending mass are invited to venerate the relics after mass. we ask for the prayers of the apostles and martyrs and all the saints. friendship club the club meets in st patrick’s parish centre, newtownards every wednesday 2pm-4pm. do come along to form and renew friendships. the club provides many opportunities for company, conversation and activities with many events organised throughout the year. please spread the word-invite friends along too!

in support of human life during this week we are asked to pray for the protection of life: -let us pray for all those approaching the end of their lives . may they be granted a peaceful, natural death with dignity and the appropriate palliative care a word of thanks! a sincere word of thanks to all who took part in the ‘tidy-up saturday on 17th october at st patrick’s. there was a wonderful turnout, and a great atmosphere. all who turned up worked really hard and were treated by the ladies of the hospitality team. thanks to one and all. for those who would like to participate in a ‘follow on saturday 21st november 10am-12noon, you will be most welcome!
